title: field.searchable: true has no reader: $search skips the field and $searchFields naming it answers 400 "is not searchable" while the served schema says searchable: true
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE
Ruled: 6573569376 · letter A · 2026-11-02T09:27Z

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix acceptance[1]).
Business reason: `field.searchable` is a declared, defaulted spec key (`field.zod.ts`, `default(false)`) that authors set expecting the field to be found by list search. Today it is stored and served, and nothing reads it: the field is not searched, and naming it in `$searchFields` is refused with "is not searchable" while the same object's served schema says `searchable: true`. A user who searches for text in that field finds nothing, and the server contradicts its own schema.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the `domain:server` lane (search-field resolution) or the `domain:spec` lane if the key should be retired in favour of `object.searchableFields` (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove). QA suggestion only: p2.
Duplicate search: `searchable field` → 122 hits; the near ones are closed and different: #28121 (resolveSearchFields fallback on unknown names), #28120 (empty searchFields read), #27705 / #27829 (secret fields in searchableFields). `resolveSearchFields searchable` → 12 hits, none about field.searchable. `searchable:true field search` → 1 hit (#13675, a skills sweep).
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. On a writable package, publish object `qar8_fsrch2` with fields `snippet {type:'code', searchable:true}` and `body {type:'html', searchable:true}` (no `searchableFields` on the object). The live read carries `searchable: true` on both.
2. `POST /api/v1/data/qar8_fsrch2 {name:'fs2 row', snippet:'select QQCODE from x', body:'(an html paragraph holding QQHTML)'}`.
3. `GET /api/v1/data/qar8_fsrch2?$search=QQCODE` and `?$search=QQHTML`, then `?$search=QQCODE&$searchFields=snippet`.

Expected: the row is found through its searchable fields. Actual: `[]`, `[]`, then 400 INVALID_FIELD "Field 'snippet' on object 'qar8_fsrch2' is not searchable. With no 'searchableFields' declared, 'search' scans the text-like columns … and 'snippet' is type 'code'". Opposite posture: on another object a text field with searchable absent is scanned exactly like one with `true`. Reproduced 3 times.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts` `resolveSearchFields` (declared searchableFields, else the type-based default set) and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-record-reads.ts` never read `field.searchable`; no `ui/` reader exists either (plugin-list and the fields search offer read only the object's `searchableFields`).

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix · acceptance[1]
